subject: Request: 15-minute technical screen before product walkthrough
messages:
From: Alex Holden <alex.holden@shelfwise.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:41:00-08:00
Subject: Quick technical screen request before demo

Hi Logan,

I signed up via the self-serve flow this morning and would like to do a short 15-minute technical scrub before we schedule a full product walkthrough. We're evaluating Redwood for low-latency recommendations and need to confirm network requirements, VPC options, and a couple of integration details.

Short background: Shelfwise runs a hybrid stack (GCP + some on-prem for sensitive inventory services). We'd like to understand whether a short pilot can hit sub-200ms P99 on nv4-like hardware and what the VPC peering/KMS options look like.

Availability (PST):
- Thu Dec 3: 10:30–12:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Fri Dec 4: 09:00–11:00

If you can give us a 15-minute slot tomorrow (Dec 3) that would be ideal. Happy to loop in our CTO Priya Rao if needed.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Holden
Head of Engineering, Shelfwise Ltd
alex.holden@shelfwise.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Holden <alex.holden@shelfwise.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick technical screen request before demo

Hi Alex — great to hear from you and thanks for signing up. I can do a 15-minute technical scrub tomorrow (Dec 3). My available slots are: 10:30am, 11:00am, and 3:15pm PST. Book whichever works via this link: https://cal.redwood.ai/logan/15 (PST times shown).

A couple quick asks so we can make the 15 minutes productive:
- Could you attach a short network/topology doc (or the key outbound IP ranges) — that helps our infra team confirm peering and egress requirements.
- Are you planning to run Private (VPC) or Hosted for the pilot?
- If you expect to test with >2 concurrent workers or long sequences, flag that so we scope the right model/size.

If you prefer, tell me which of my slots you want and I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.ai

Thanks — booked 10:30am PST via your calendar link.

Attaching the network requirements spreadsheet for the triage: shelfwise-network-requirements.xlsx (see attachment).

Notes:
- We'll likely start with Hosted API for the pilot but need the option to move to Private (VPC) for production.
- Typical payloads: short prompts + metadata, expected bursty traffic during batch jobs — not more than 5 concurrent inference workers for the pilot.
- We use GCP in us-west1 for most services; encryption via GCP KMS.

Please confirm invite and whether Marissa (your CS engineer) should join. I'll loop in Priya Rao (CTO) on the internal side.

— Alex
